title: Plum Lazy Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Plum Lazy is a wonderfully appointed and decorated cottage conveniently located behind the Ruskin Place Artist Colony and near the shops and restaurants of Central Square.
description_expanded: Description109 W RUSKIN PLACE1 KING, 1 QUEEN, 1 TWINPrime Location Near Ruskin Place & Central SquareWhen you imagine a quintessential Seaside, Florida getaway, Plum Lazy immediately comes to mind. Ideally tucked behind the charming Ruskin Place Artist Colony, this inviting cottage places you just steps from the heart of Seaside. A short stroll leads you to Central Square, where boutique shops, local galleries, and beloved restaurants create the vibrant coastal atmosphere Seaside is known for—all while enjoying a peaceful, tucked-away setting.Cozy First-Floor Living & Dining SpacesInside, the first floor welcomes you with a warm and comfortable living area designed for unwinding after a sun-filled beach day. The cozy sitting space flows seamlessly into the adjacent dining area, making it easy to gather for meals or casual evenings in. The fully equipped kitchen offers everything needed to prepare morning coffee, beach-day snacks, or home-cooked dinners, blending everyday convenience with relaxed coastal living.Comfortable Second-Floor BedroomsUpstairs, two thoughtfully designed bedrooms provide restful retreats for family and friends. The spacious primary bedroom features a king-size bed and a private ensuite bathroom with a walk-in shower. The second bedroom offers flexible accommodations with a queen-size bed and a twin bed, ideal for children or additional guests, and enjoys access to a full bathroom just down the hall.Inviting Outdoor Porches for RelaxationPlum Lazy truly shines when it comes to outdoor living. The charming front porch offers a perfect spot for people-watching and soaking in Seaside’s gentle coastal breeze. Upstairs, a larger furnished porch creates an ideal setting for afternoon lounging or evening cocktails as the sun sets over the town, delivering a relaxed and memorable seaside experience.Your Ideal Seaside Home BaseWhether you’re planning a peaceful coastal escape or a fun-filled adventure exploring all that Seaside has to offer, Plum Lazy provides the perfect home base. With its unbeatable location, comfortable interiors, and inviting outdoor spaces, this cottage captures the essence of Seaside living and invites you to slow down, relax, and enjoy every moment.For additional accommodations for larger groups, the 2-bedroom cottage next door, Plum Crazy, can also be rented to create a four-bedroom space. The two cottages are connected by the second-story porches. That makes you Plum Lucky, which is the name of the combination of the two homes being rented together.5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer | 3 night minimum Fall | 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURESSeaside Private Residential Beach: Located at West Ruskin PavilionBeach Access: 4-minute walk (352 yards) to beach accessAmenity Access: 3 swimming pools, 5 Clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerLuxury Linens: Peacock Alley linens with fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized Service: Attentive guest service throughout your stayStarter Amenities: Essentials provided upon arrivalParking: One parking pass issued for one-bedroom cottages; two parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a carGolf Cart Policy: Golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances and medical needs require an approved golf cart permitPets: No pets allowedSTR23-002136
